fact_check.claim: Jan 31 is the last day returning juniors and seniors can cancel a Cornell license for $50; it rises to $500 from Feb 1
fact_check.note: Brief: through Jan 31 $50; Feb 1 to Mar 31 $500. Same value, same group (returning juniors and seniors).

fact_check.claim: Apr 6 (in 2026): the Cornell housing application is due, including exemption requests
fact_check.source_url: brief §3 (2026-27 housing application deadline) and §4.1 April
fact_check.note: Brief: AY 2026-27 application due April 6, 2026, exemption requests included. The page also flags that the 2027 date is not in the brief.

fact_check.claim: On or about Aug 1: most leases start; the landlord must offer a move-in inspection before your student moves in
fact_check.note: Brief: most 12-month leases start about Aug 1; landlord must offer an inspection after signing and before occupancy.

fact_check.claim: July 31: most leases end, and the deposit or an itemized statement is due within 14 days of moving out
fact_check.note: Brief: most Ithaca leases expire July 31; deposit or itemized statement within 14 days after the tenant vacates.

fact_check.claim: September to November of sophomore year: groups that want Collegetown sign for junior year, and the first month and deposit may be due at signing
fact_check.source_url: brief §4.1 (late Aug to Nov rows) and §6 step 5
fact_check.note: Brief: students report signing in October of sophomore year; the rush runs late August to November; first month plus deposit due at signing (209 Stewart, Cityview). The page says 'may', which matches.

fact_check.claim: Cornell housing cancellation fee calculator exists and computes cancellation cost on a given date for a student who signs a lease instead
fact_check.note: The tool's check and review files exist under content/checks and content/reviews; the schedule it uses is the brief's. The tool page itself is checked under its own row.

fact_check.claim: Guide titles and what each housing guide covers (pillar, parents' guide, off-campus vs dorm 'rent per person set against Cornell's double', residential requirement and exemptions, landlord checking, roommates and joint liability, deposit cap/14 days/banned fees, renters insurance need and cost)
fact_check.note: All eight linked slugs exist and each link text matches the guide's frontmatter title exactly. Each one-line description agrees with that guide's meta (e.g. the double compared with rent per person; deposit capped at one month, 14 days; renters insurance recommended, not required).

fact_check.claim: Parents often pay or co-sign, cannot see the Cornell housing marketplace without a NetID
fact_check.note: Framing statement in the intro, consistent with the brief's parent guidance; it carries no number or date.

fact_check.claim: Not in the brief: the 2027 date for the Cornell housing application
fact_check.note: Brief lists only the April 6, 2026 date, so the page's Not-confirmed line is accurate.
